messages:
Anna (AM): Quick sync for Acme POC — we need a final prompt slate, baseline eval metrics, timeline, and answers for the security questionnaire by EOD Friday. Can SEs + Presales confirm what they need from the customer?
Sam - Solutions Eng: On it. I'll paste the baseline prompts I plan to use and the eval plan. Any PII constraints we should bake in?
Maria - Presales: Customer says EU data residency only, logs retained max 30 days, and they need KMS + SOC2 addendum. I uploaded their security questionnaire to the deal folder.
Mike - InfraOps: Heads up — Private (VPC) deployment needs ~2 weeks lead time to provision infra. Dedicated with customer VPC peering is faster (~5 business days) if networking is already approved.
DevDeployBot: Provision request #3852 created for dedicated-reserve-acme. Status: queued.
Legal-Sec: Security team requests: KMS design doc, subprocessor list, encryption-at-rest confirmation, logging retention controls, and pen-test cadence. Maria, can you attach the signed questionnaire PDF here?
Maria - Presales: Attached in drive: acme_sec_qs_v1.pdf. Also flagged the residency ask — they want all inference logs kept in eu-west-1 only.
Sam - Solutions Eng: Baseline prompts (first pass):
```
Prompt A - summarizer: "You are an assistant that ingests banking transaction notes and returns JSON {summary, key_actions[], risk_flags[]}. Keep output under 150 tokens. Preserve numeric values. If unsure, set risk_flags to 'needs_review'"

Prompt B - tone rewrite: "Rewrite the input for a customer-facing short summary. Tone: professional, concise. Max tokens: 120."
```
Sam - Solutions Eng: Eval plan: 100 labelled examples (mix of transaction notes, support emails). Metrics: summary ROUGE-L, key_actions recall/precision (F1 target > 0.92), false positive rate on risk_flags < 5%. Latency targets: p50 < 300ms, p95 < 600ms for standard 512-token context. Cost target: <$1.20 per 1k tokens as a POC goal.
Anna (AM): Good — add an adversarial subset (20 examples) for risky phrasing. Also define rollback criteria if accuracy drops >5% vs baseline during rollout.
Sam - Solutions Eng: Will add adversarial tests. Need anonymized sample set (100 examples) from the customer to run the baseline. Can we get that by tomorrow?
Maria - Presales: I'll request anonymized export today and ask them to confirm legal redaction rules.
Mike - InfraOps: For dedicated path: we'll need a signed NDA and network allowlist. If they want private cloud/on-prem, infra ETA moves to 3+ weeks.
Maria - Presales: Pricing question from the customer: do we have a short-term reserved option for POC (30 days) with predictable cost?
Anna (AM): Yes — offer a 1-month reserved capacity at a discounted rate (proposal: 25% off for the POC) and variable usage overage. Sam, include estimated token usage bands in the proposal (low/med/high).
Sam - Solutions Eng: I'll estimate tokens: low=50k/day, med=200k/day, high=600k/day (based on 10k sessions/day). Will model cost for each.
Legal-Sec: Maria — once we have the questionnaire answers, legal needs 48 hours to review KMS/subprocessors. Please flag any required attestation.
Maria - Presales: Noted. I told the customer legal review window.
Anna (AM): Action items: Sam -> paste final prompt slate + run baseline once samples arrive; Maria -> collect anonymized samples + security questionnaire answers; Mike -> confirm dedicated vs private timelines in calendar invite; Legal-Sec -> review KMS/subprocessor docs when attached. Can everyone confirm by EOD? :thumbsup:
Sam - Solutions Eng: Confirmed, will paste final prompts and the eval harness config here after lunch.
Maria - Presales: Confirmed.
Mike - InfraOps: Confirmed.
Legal-Sec: Will review once docs are posted.
Anna (AM): Thanks team — I'll draft the POC statement of work and the email to Acme with deadlines after this thread. :rocket:
